value.rationale: The only two order-twelve Archimedean graphs form a canonical comparison, with the truncated tetrahedral cubic case immediately beyond a published at-most-ten classification and the cuboctahedron furnishing a natural cube edge-coalition benchmark. Their equal sharp optimum eight masks very different complete spectra (1,215,276 versus 886,256 total coalition partitions), optimum profiles and 23 versus 7 symmetry orbits. This is a motivated complete finite classification with reusable certificates, not an arbitrary instance.
